title: Here’s how to listen live to Tim Cook’s last earnings call as Apple CEO
summary: Apple will soon report its fiscal third-quarter 2026 earnings, followed by Tim Cook’s final earnings call as the company’s CEO. This will mark the last time Tim Cook joins the call as Apple’s CEO, and his 90th earnings call overall.
